messages:
sandeep: Heads-up — we saw a burst of 413s on /v1/embeddings this morning. Spike correlated with large payloads that include mixed dims (512 + 1536) in the same request. telemetry shows ~0.8% of embedding requests in the burst failed with 413.
maria: ack. Is the runtime attempting to split mixed-dim payloads currently or do we fast-fail? :thinking:
jkeller: runtime only auto-splits when dims are uniform. mixed dims -> 413. splitting mixed dims would require per-item route/multiplexing; adds latency and more in-flight RPCs, plus double-accounting risk in metrics/cost.
david: quick context: many client SDKs assume homogeneous dims. When they send mixed dims it's usually client bug, or convenience from batching different generation pipelines. We could auto-split server-side but that ups complexity and cost.
sandeep: telemetry detail: sampled requests show server tried to accept then hit 413 at splitter: "request_size_bytes": 2.5MB, "items": 120, dims_hist: {512:50,1536:70}. If we split into two batches we'd be fine, but it explodes number of per-batch RPCs and affects our token-per-second budgeting.
maria: UX question for the console — should we surface a per-route "split/fastfail" meter so customers can see how often we fast-fail vs auto-split? also show suggested fix (e.g., client-side split guidance or header to opt-in)
jkeller: I like a console tile: rate of 413_mixed_dim, avg items, avg bytes, top offending clients. Actionable links: open SDK quickfix snippets.
david: operationally, I prefer default fast-fail + clear error+hint. Then we offer an opt-in header `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true` to let customers elect server-side split with the known tradeoffs. That keeps default predictable for our billing and SLOs.
maria: agree. fast-fail by default reduces surprise cost regressions. But we need a migration path for legit customers who rely on server-side convenience.
sandeep: telemetry events we need:
- `embed.request.received` tags: model, route, client_id, items, dims_signature (e.g., "50x512+70x1536"), size_bytes
- `embed.split.invoked` tags: original_batch_id, split_count, split_strategy
- `embed.fastfail` tags: reason=mixed_dims|oversize, hint_sent=true
- `embed.split.latency_ms` (histogram)

jkeller: console alerts: fire if `embed.fastfail.rate` > 0.5% over 5m for production routes. Also add a per-model cost delta when auto-splitting is on (estimated additional RPCs * p95 latency).
david: error payload suggestion — short, machine-readable, and helpful for SDKs:

```json
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{
  "error": "mixed_dims_and_over_limit",
  "hint": "Use client-side splitting or set header X-Embed-AutoSplit: true to opt into server-side splitting. See https://redwood.ai/docs/embeddings#split-hints",
  "meta": {"expected_max_items": "<=64", "received_items": 120}
}
```

maria: +1 on the error shape. Also include a `diagnostic_id` (traceable in console) so users can open support with link.
ci-bot: build/telemetry-instrumentation will run tests on PRs that add new metrics. :white_check_mark:
sandeep: rollout plan proposal:
1) implement fast-fail + error hint + diagnostic_id (hotfix) — owner: david — 1 week
2) instrument telemetry metrics/events — owner: maria — 1 week parallel
3) console tile + alerts + top offenders list — owner: jkeller — 2 weeks
4) implement `X-Embed-AutoSplit` opt-in server-side split (beta); gated behind feature flag and dedicated-pool toggle — owner: engineering-runtime — 3 weeks

jkeller: tiny UX note: console tile should surface "suggested fix" code snippet for each offending client (python/js snippet to split before send). Make copy short.
david: SDK change: add `auto_split_mixed_dims=true` flag in next release so clients can opt into pre-splitting automatically. We'll also log a warning when SDK encounters mixed dims.
maria: telemetry question — do we sample full payloads or only metadata? We should avoid storing raw content for compliance. Capture dims_signature, items, size_bytes, diagnostic_id only.
sandeep: yes, keep PII/contents out. store only metadata and sampling of payload hashes if needed for debugging.
jkeller: one more internal API debate — do we require an explicit `X-Embed-Shape` header from clients (declare dims) to avoid runtime parsing and make routing cheaper? Pros: faster preflight; cons: it's a breaking change for clients.
david: I'd rather not break defaults. If we add `X-Embed-Shape` it's an optional hint we can use to pre-validate and refuse earlier. Accepts both but prefer hinted path when present.
maria: ok decision summary for the ticket:
- default behavior: fast-fail mixed-dim/oversize with helpful 413 error + diagnostic_id
- add `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true` opt-in header for server-side splitting (feature-flagged)
- add optional `X-Embed-Shape` header as optimization/hint
- instrument metrics/events described above (no raw content)
- console tile + alerts + quickfix snippets

sandeep: assigning tasks: david -> hotfix + error shape, maria -> telemetry + sampling, jkeller -> console tile + alert config. I'll own runtime feature flag gating and rollout docs.
maria: I'll open the telemetry PR today and include the event schema in the description. cc @jkeller @david
jkeller: I'll mock the console tile this afternoon and post screenshots in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
david: starting hotfix branch now. Will ping when ready for review.
ci-bot: PR #4247 created by david: fix/embeddings-fastfail-error-shape
sandeep: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after initial telemetry is in. :rocket:
